description: Skelet G09-03 Playwright isolated capture worker exact-diff audit

state.scope: New secret-free IPC child, DNS-pinned HTTP ingress with strict HTML bytes/redirect deadline, JavaScript/network-disabled Playwright partial screenshot, offline tests, frozen Playwright dependency, lens CI

security.instructions: Does the worker permit private IP, DNS rebinding, redirect bypass, browser network access, ambient secret inheritance, unsafe filesystem side effect, or credential leakage?

correctness.instructions: Any material error in DNS-pinned TCP/TLS, response streaming cap, redirect hop budget, browser HTML setContent, IPC results, screenshot evidence, or status partial?

reliability.instructions: Could the worker hang or leak a Chrome process, exhaust CPU/memory through large HTML/assets, mishandle exceptions, or return a false successful artifact?

compatibility.instructions: Does pinned playwright-core 1.56.1 or runner shell installation conflict with Node 22.23.1 or Ubuntu 24.04 CI?

evidence.instructions: Do unit and Chromium fixture tests adequately prove secret-free env, SSRF fail-closed, byte/time limits, script isolation, browser cleanup, and stable evidence?

scope.instructions: Is the change limited to G09-03 capture worker, no unsolicited P09 provider, report or UI?
